looking_after_the_crop.text: Tie cordons loosely, remove young side shoots and take off yellow lower leaves sparingly. Stop two leaves above the final truss at the chosen height or near season’s end.
Water roots steadily and feed organically at the product’s rate as fruit develops. Ventilate in heat, tap flowering trusses gently and adjust autumn watering to growth.

harvesting.text: Pick fully coloured fruit gently and use promptly. Bring sound unripe fruit indoors before cold ends the crop; check ripening trays and discard decay.

tomato_greenhouse.reason: Page two is 13 mm over. Combine overlapping training/seasonal-care and harvesting actions, keeping all ten problems and the complete sowing note.

looking_after_the_crop.text: Support and side-shoot cordons; remove yellow leaves sparingly. Stop above the final useful truss by late summer. Bush types normally need no side-shooting or stopping.
Water roots steadily and feed organically as fruit develops. Keep low fruit off wet soil. Ventilated cloches reduce rain on foliage; fleece does not prevent blight.

harvesting.text: Pick fully coloured fruit gently and use promptly. Bring sound unripe fruit indoors at season’s end; ripen in shallow trays, check regularly and discard rot.

Combined aphid/whitefly source row retained at low priority rather than printed twice. Lesser root/stem rots, leaf-roll physiology, sun/greenback/blotchy ripening and rare pests remain in full shared guide; heat/moisture/feeding prevention covered. Soil/care remove repeated growbag advice, replace artificial feed with organic feeding and avoid blanket misting. Cordon/bush distinctions, stopping, gentle leaf removal, pollination and late ripening retained. Source planting pairless old measurements are not injected into new extracts.
coverage.tomato_outdoor: Nine useful outdoor issues: four inline plus blossom-end rot, aphids, virus, grey mould and blossom drop. Greenhouse whitefly is host-scoped out; leaf mould is chiefly under-cover and not prioritised. Other specialist rots/physiological disorders retained in shared source. Blight aliases combined. Soil/care and harvest explicitly separate cordons from bushes, keep steady water and support, and preserve late indoor ripening without unnecessary universal pruning. Seed timing and variety spacing retained; approved illustrated route unchanged.
coverage.capsicum: Nine distinct useful capsicum problems: all seven inline plus whitefly and grey mould confirmed in RHS crop guidance. Full red-spider/aphid chemical prescriptions replaced with biological/cultural controls; unsubstantiated bean-distance anthracnose rule replaced by diagnosis/hygiene. Soil/care balance warmth, steady moisture, airflow, organic feeding and support. Harvest distinguishes green yield versus mature colour and chilli drying; source-wide claim that every ripe chilli is hotter not repeated. No fixed minimum temperature asserted for every cultivar; propagation temperature is correctly unit-paired.
